points.title: 少年出家
points.description: 玄奘出生于河南洛阳附近的一个官宦家庭，原名陈祎。13岁时在洛阳净土寺出家，师从佛经大师。在此期间，他系统学习了佛教经典，对经文中的矛盾之处产生疑问，立志西行求取真经。这一阶段奠定了他深厚的佛学基础和坚定的求法决心，为他日后西行取经埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Xuanzang was born into an official family in Luoyang, Henan. At age 13, he became a monk at the Jingsu Temple in Luoyang, studying under Buddhist masters. During this period, he systematically studied Buddhist scriptures but discovered contradictions in the texts, which inspired his determination to journey westward to seek authentic scriptures. This phase established his profound Buddhist foundation and unwavering determination for his later journey to obtain true Buddhist texts.

points.title: 长安求学
points.description: 玄奘前往唐朝首都长安，在各大寺院学习佛法，师从多位高僧。他遍览佛经，发现各派学说存在诸多矛盾，特别是关于瑜伽行派的经典残缺不全。在此期间，他向朝廷申请西行求法，但未获批准。尽管如此，他并未放弃，暗中为西行做准备，包括学习西域各国语言和地理知识，为日后艰苦卓绝的西行之旅奠定基础。
points.descriptionEn: Xuanzang traveled to Chang'an, the Tang Dynasty capital, where he studied Buddhism in various monasteries under multiple masters. He extensively read Buddhist scriptures but found numerous contradictions among different schools, especially regarding the incomplete texts of the Yogācāra school. During this time, he applied to the imperial court for permission to travel westward for Buddhist scriptures but was denied. Despite this, he did not give up and secretly prepared for his journey, including learning languages and geography of Western regions, laying the foundation for his arduous westward journey.

points.title: 西行求法
points.description: 玄奘于贞观元年（627年）私自离开长安，开始了长达19年的西行求法之旅。他穿越河西走廊，历经高昌、龟兹等西域国家，翻越帕米尔高原，到达印度。在印度，他遍访佛教圣地，在那烂陀寺从戒贤法师学习瑜伽行派佛法，历时五年。他还游历印度全境，收集了大量佛经。期间，他曾与外道辩论获胜，声名远播。这段经历不仅使他获得了丰富的佛学知识，也锻炼了他的意志和智慧，为日后翻译佛经奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 627, Xuanzang secretly left Chang'an, beginning his 19-year journey westward for Buddhist scriptures. He crossed the Hexi Corridor, passed through Western Regions like Gaochang and Qiuci, crossed the Pamir Plateau, and reached India. In India, he visited Buddhist holy sites, studied Yogācā Buddhism under Master Jiyang at Nalanda Monastery for five years. He traveled throughout India, collecting numerous Buddhist scriptures. During this time, he won debates with non-Buddhist scholars, gaining widespread fame. This experience not only enriched his Buddhist knowledge but also tempered his will and wisdom, laying a solid foundation for his later translation work.

points.title: 回归译经
points.description: 贞观十九年（645年），玄奘携带657部梵文佛经回到长安，受到唐太宗热烈欢迎。他在弘福寺、慈恩寺等处设立译场，开始大规模翻译佛经工作。他组织译经团队，采用'直译'与'意译'相结合的方法，翻译了大量佛经，包括《大般若经》《瑜伽师地论》等重要经典。他还口述《大唐西域记》，记录了西域各国的风土人情、地理历史，成为研究古代中亚和印度的重要史料。这一时期是他翻译事业的黄金时期，对中国佛教发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 645, Xuanzang returned to Chang'an with 657 Sanskrit Buddhist scriptures, warmly welcomed by Emperor Taizong of Tang. He established translation centers at monasteries like Hongfu Temple and Ci'en Temple, beginning large-scale scripture translation work. He organized translation teams, using a combination of literal and free translation methods to translate numerous Buddhist scriptures, including important works like the Great Prajnaparamita Sutra and Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra. He also dictated the 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions,' documenting the customs, geography, and history of Western countries, becoming an important historical source for studying ancient Central Asia and India. This period marked the golden age of his translation career, profoundly influencing the development of Chinese Buddhism.

points.title: 皇家支持
points.description: 唐太宗去世后，唐高宗继续支持玄奘的译经事业。玄奘在慈恩寺主持修建大雁塔，用于存放从印度带回的佛经和佛像。他还完成了《大唐西域记》的整理工作，并继续翻译佛经。这一时期，他的译经事业得到官方大力支持，译场规模扩大，翻译质量提高。他还培养了众多弟子，传承佛法。大雁塔的建成不仅是中国佛教建筑的重要里程碑，也成为玄奘西行求法的历史象征。
points.descriptionEn: After Emperor Taizong's death, Emperor Gaozong continued to support Xuanzang's translation work. Xuanzang supervised the construction of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda at Ci'en Temple to house the Buddhist scriptures and statues brought back from India. He completed the compilation of 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions' and continued translating Buddhist scriptures. During this period, his translation work received strong official support, with expanded translation teams and improved quality. He also trained numerous disciples to spread Buddhism. The completion of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda was not only an important milestone in Chinese Buddhist architecture but also became a historical symbol of Xuanzang's westward journey for Buddhist scriptures.

points.title: 晚年译经
points.description: 玄奘晚年移居长安玉华寺，继续翻译佛经，特别是《大般若经》等重要经典。他晚年健康状况不佳，但仍坚持工作，完成了《大般若经》的翻译。麟德元年（664年），玄奘在玉华寺圆寂，享年63岁。他一生翻译佛经75部，1335卷，是中国佛教翻译史上成就最高者之一。他的弟子们整理了他的著作和译经，形成了系统的唯识宗理论，对中国佛教发展产生了深远影响。玄奘的西行取经故事也成为中国文化中的重要象征，被后世不断传颂。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Xuanzang moved to Yuhua Temple in Chang'an, continuing to translate Buddhist scriptures, especially important works like the Great Prajnaparamita Sutra. Despite declining health, he persisted in his work and completed the translation of the Great Prajnaparamita Sutra. In 664, Xuanzang passed away at Yuhua Temple at the age of 63. Throughout his life, he translated 75 Buddhist scriptures totaling 1,335 volumes, making him one of the most accomplished figures in Chinese Buddhist translation history. His disciples compiled his works and translations, forming the systematic theory of the Yogācāra school, which profoundly influenced the development of Chinese Buddhism. Xuanzang's journey to the West for Buddhist scriptures has also become an important symbol in Chinese culture, continuously celebrated by later generations.

appraisal.zh: 玄奘通常被视为中国佛教史上最伟大的翻译家与佛学家之一，其西行求法体现对真理的执着，译经系统完整、准确度高，为佛教发展奠定基础，《大唐西域记》更是研究古代中亚与印度史地的珍贵史料。也有研究者指出，他私自出境违反唐初禁令，所创唯识宗后来影响有限，民间形象又被过度神化，与历史真实相去甚远。总体而言，他作为中印佛教交流关键人物与文化交流使者的地位，仍是学界主流判断。
appraisal.en: Xuanzang is generally regarded as one of the greatest translators and scholars in Chinese Buddhist history: his westward journey embodied a pursuit of truth, his translations were systematic and accurate, and his Records of the Western Regions remains a precious source for Central Asian and Indian history and geography. Yet some researchers note that he left the country without permission, that the Yogācāra school he founded had limited later influence, and that his folk image is overly mythologized. Still, his standing as a key figure in Sino-Indian Buddhist and cultural exchange remains the mainstream scholarly judgment.

supporter.zh: 玄奘是中国佛教史上最伟大的翻译家和佛学家之一，他西行求法的壮举体现了对真理的执着追求。他翻译的佛经系统完整，准确度高，为中国佛教发展奠定了坚实基础。他不仅是一位杰出的学者，更是一位勇敢的探险家，不畏艰难险阻，为中外文化交流做出了不可磨灭的贡献。玄奘的精神激励着后人追求真理、勇于探索，是中国文化精神的杰出代表。
supporter.en: Xuanzang stands as one of the greatest Buddhist translators and scholars in Chinese history. His westward journey for Buddhist scriptures embodies a relentless pursuit of truth. His translations are systematic, complete, and highly accurate, laying a solid foundation for the development of Chinese Buddhism. He was not only an outstanding scholar but also a brave explorer who fearlessly faced hardships, making indelible contributions to cultural exchange between China and foreign countries. Xuanzang's spirit continues to inspire later generations to pursue truth and explore courageously, representing the essence of Chinese cultural spirit.

critic.zh: 从某些角度看，玄奘的西行取经也存在争议。他私自出境，违反了当时唐朝的禁令；他翻译的佛经虽然数量庞大，但部分内容与中国传统文化存在冲突；他创立的唯识宗后来在中国佛教中影响有限，未能成为主流宗派。此外，民间传说中的玄奘形象与历史人物存在较大差异，被过度神化，掩盖了其作为普通僧人的历史真实面。
critic.en: From certain perspectives, Xuanzang's westward journey also has controversies. He secretly left the country, violating the Tang Dynasty's prohibition against foreign travel. Although his translated scriptures are numerous, some content conflicts with traditional Chinese culture. The Yogācāra school he founded had limited influence in Chinese Buddhism and never became a mainstream sect. Furthermore, the popular image of Xuanzang in folklore differs significantly from the historical figure, being overly mythologized and obscuring his true identity as an ordinary monk.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，玄奘被视为一位杰出的文化交流使者和中印佛教交流的关键人物。他的《大唐西域记》是研究古代中亚和印度历史地理的珍贵史料。在流行文化中，玄奘的形象经历了从历史人物到文学形象的演变，特别是在《西游记》中被塑造为唐僧，成为中国文化中的经典符号。现代学术界对玄奘的研究已超越宗教范畴，将其置于中外文化交流史、丝绸之路历史和唐代社会文化的大背景下进行考察，展现出其多维度历史价值。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Xuanzang is regarded as an outstanding cultural exchange ambassador and a key figure in Sino-Indian Buddhist exchange. His 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions' serves as a valuable historical source for studying ancient Central Asian and Indian history and geography. In popular culture, Xuanzang's image has evolved from a historical figure to a literary character, particularly portrayed as Tang Sanzang in 'Journey to the West,' becoming a classic symbol in Chinese culture. Modern academic research on Xuanzang has transcended religious boundaries, examining him within the broader contexts of cultural exchange history, the Silk Road, and Tang Dynasty society and culture, revealing his multidimensional historical significance.

self.zh: 宁可向西一步而死，决不向东一步而生。
self.en: Rather take one step westward towards death than one step eastward towards life.
